note: Doctor identity plus laptop cannot share the canvas: a medical cross on the bust's chest needs a chest band 8 clear on every side (bust about 28 wide and 30 tall including the r6+ head and 8 gap), and the laptop (screen + base, holes >= 6) needs another ~20x16 at 8 from it; together about 52 of 36-40 units. Without the cross the bust is a generic user, which is the rejected meaning problem.
